en-US.author: Tailwind Labs
en-US.description: Rapidly build modern websites without ever leaving your HTML.
en-US.longDescription:
Tailwind CSS works by scanning all of your HTML files, JavaScript components, and any other templates for class names, generating the corresponding styles and then writing them to a static CSS file.
It's fast, flexible, and reliable — with zero-runtime.
en-US.name: Tailwind CSS
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fixed
- Canonicalization: improve performance in projects with many functional variant values (e.g. a matchVariant plugin with thousands of values) (#20663)
- Don't crash or create a fallback with the wrong color for a color-mix(…) without a color interpolation method (e.g. color-mix(var(--color-red-500)) or color-mix(currentcolor 50%, transparent)) (#20658, #20666)
- Ensure @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi loads instead of hanging forever (e.g. with NAPI_RS_FORCE_WASI=error or in WebContainers) (#20667)
- Remove as: '*.css' from the @tailwindcss/turbopack setup in its README, because it breaks CSS modules (#20660)
- Ignore <!-- and --> between top-level rules in CSS instead of throwing or swallowing the next rule (e.g. a { color: red } --> b { color: blue }) (#20665)
- Ensure @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi detects changed and new source files after the first scan (e.g. in WebContainers) (#20487)
- Prevent type errors with skipLibCheck: false caused by imports of unshipped modules in the @tailwindcss/node type declarations (#20632)

zh-CN.author: Tailwind Labs
zh-CN.description: 无需脱离 HTML 就能快速构建现代网站

zh-CN.name: Tailwind CSS
